links.text: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth

blocks.text: Pitt, who reprises his Once Upon a Time in Hollywood role in this sequel written by Quentin Tarantino, walked the red carpet alongside his significant other, Inés de Ramón.

blocks.text: Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years after Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Tarantino’s parallel 1969 history, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood .

The fairy tale is now over in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth . Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s great and, sometimes, not so good.
RELATED: ‘The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth’: New Photos Of Film Starring Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II & More

links.text: ‘The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth’: New Photos Of Film Starring Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II & More

blocks.text: He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Groove and Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city. What was once a fairy tale is now a crime story — a cocktail of violence, ambition, and desire that could only happen in LA.
